description: Remove the stale 'SlashCommand' token from the ADR 0020 runtime-tools enumeration

userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: CRITICAL [scripts/cam/prd.json:16]: Layer B behavioral-gate FAIL: US-001 acceptance criterion AC4 [oracle: file-assert git diff --name-only main | grep -qx '<adr>' && [ $(git diff --name-only main | wc -l) -eq 1 ]] fails on the reviewer's independent re-run. git diff --name-only main reports 3 changed files (the ADR plus scripts/cam/prd.json and scripts/cam/handoff.json), not 1, so the oracle returns non-zero. The intent (orchestrator frontmatter + code unchanged) is actually satisfied - no .claude/agents/*, src/*, or templates/* touched - but the oracle as written is structurally unsatisfiable in the cam workflow because the workflow itself commits prd.json and handoff.json to the branch. Fix: scope the oracle to exclude cam scaffolding, e.g. `git diff --name-only main -- ':(exclude)scripts/cam/'` before the grep/count. A failing Layer B oracle is a hard-constraint FAIL and cannot be narrated green.

The runtime-usage tools list in that ADR line reads 'Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, WebFetch, Write, Skill, Task/Agent'. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, WebFetch, Write, Skill, Task/Agent' docs/adr/0020-orchestrator-runs-as-an-enforced-agent-agent-not-a-catted-prompt.md]

'Skill' remains listed in the ADR tools list (valid granted tool since CAM-255). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'Skill' docs/adr/0020-orchestrator-runs-as-an-enforced-agent-agent-not-a-catted-prompt.md]

No file other than the ADR is modified; orchestrator frontmatter and code are unchanged. [oracle: file-assert git diff --name-only main -- ':(exclude)scripts/cam/' | grep -qx 'docs/adr/0020-orchestrator-runs-as-an-enforced-agent-agent-not-a-catted-prompt.md' && [ $(git diff --name-only main -- ':(exclude)scripts/cam/' | wc -l) -eq 1 ]]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
